primary.title: PPF vs SIPs: Here's how much corpus an investment of ₹2,000 per month for 30 years give you?
primary.summary: PPF vs SIPs: Planning your long-term investments? Take a look at how much corpus is generated from an investment of ₹2,000 per month for 30 years with the public provident fund and in mutual funds through systematic investment plans.

related.title: How to move your PPF account between banks or post offices; Can it transferred to another person?
